title: Event X1 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes better than threshold2)

entities.name: Event X1
entities.description: Measurement reporting event triggered when the serving L2 U2N relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and an NR cell becomes better than threshold2.

entities.name: Serving L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: The current Layer 2 UE-to-Network relay serving the UE.

entities.name: NR Cell
entities.description: A New Radio cell considered for measurement comparison.

entities.name: Threshold1
entities.description: Threshold value for determining when the serving L2 U2N relay UE becomes worse.

entities.name: Threshold2
entities.description: Threshold value for determining when an NR cell becomes better.

entities.name: UE Measurement Reporting
entities.description: Procedure where the UE performs measurements and reports events based on configured thresholds.

relations.description: Event X1 is triggered when the serving L2 U2N relay UE measurement becomes worse than threshold1.
Event X1 is triggered when an NR cell measurement becomes better than threshold2.
Event X1 uses threshold1 to evaluate the serving L2 U2N relay UE condition.
Event X1 uses threshold2 to evaluate the NR cell condition.
The UE measurement reporting procedure includes monitoring for Event X1.
